question: The Government of India, by passing an Act in the year ______, revoked the special constitutional status of the erstwhile state of Jammu and Kashmir.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **special status, or limited autonomy, that Jammu and Kashmir** had been accorded **under Article 370** of the Indian Constitution was **removed by the Indian government on August 5, 2019.**
 
• **The President of India issued the Constitution (Application to Jammu and Kashmir) Order 2019 **, which e**liminated J&K's special status** and extended all of the Indian Constitution's provisions to the region.
 
• **The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019** was the name of the law that the Indian government passed which **divided the state of Jammu and Kashmir into Ladakh and Jammu and Kashmir, two distinct Union Territories.**
 
• A Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court affirmed the President of India's authority to revoke Article 370 of the Indian Constitution on December 11, 2023, with a majority decision. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Article 370:**

 
• It was included in **Part XXI** of the Constitution: **"Temporary, Transitional and Special Provisions."**
 
• The constitutional provision known as **Article 370 granted Jammu and Kashmir its unique status.**
 
• It **allows J&K to create its own constitution** and spares the state from the provisions of the Indian Constitution (except from Article 370 and Article 1).
 
• It** limits Parliament's ability **to enact laws pertaining to J&K and requires just "consultation" with the state government in order **to extend a central law** on topics **covered by the Instrument of Accession (IoA).**
 
• **In 1947, Governor General Lord Mountbatten and Raja Hari Singh of the then-princely state of J&K signed the IoA.**
 
• The** IoA granted Parliament the authority to enact laws only pertaining to communications, defence, and external affairs with regard to J&K.**
